fields.Name: T196 - Integrations Activity Drilldown
fields.Description: Opens the Integrations app's Activity section and views the activity/run log. Verifies the log renders with rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Integrations application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) - the pinned app list is short and Integrations is visible without scrolling. Open the Activity section and view the activity/run log. If log rows are present, click one row to view its details. The success state is the Integrations Activity view rendered, showing the activity/run log (rows, or a drilled-in run detail) OR a valid empty-state. This is a platform view that may have sparse data in a fresh regression DB, so accept an empty-state as long as the Activity view renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Integrations application is active and the Activity section is open
The activity/run log renders rows (or a drilled-in run detail) or a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
